'''Team Blade''' was an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] unit. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the team was posted to [[Outpost Cinder]] and tasked with developing a plan to rescue Alliance prisoners from the [[Bid'jerma Detention Block]]. Team Blade was commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Teracca Torrh]].<ref name="HS" />
